name: experiment-record
title: Experiment record
for_each: select id,code from experiments order by code

sections.title: Protocol version
sections.sql: select p.code,p.version,p.title,p.body from protocols p join experiments e on e.protocol_id=p.id where e.id=$1

sections.title: Observations and corrections
sections.sql: select kind,body,observed_on,author,supersedes from entries where experiment_id=$1 order by created_at,id

sections.title: Raw evidence references
sections.sql: select label,location,sha256,captured_on from artifacts where experiment_id=$1 order by label

sections.title: Independent review record
sections.note: Declared names are not verified identities or regulated electronic signatures.
sections.sql: select reviewer,decision,revision,evidence_ref,created_at from reviews where experiment_id=$1 order by created_at,id

name: project-handover
title: Project handover record
for_each: select id,code from projects order by code

sections.title: Experiment register
sections.sql: select code,title,owner,state,due_on from experiments where project_id=$1 order by code

sections.title: Outstanding actions
sections.sql: select a.code,a.description,a.owner,a.due_on from actions a join experiments e on e.id=a.experiment_id where e.project_id=$1 and a.resolved_on is null order by a.due_on,a.code

name: archive-reconciliation
title: Archive reconciliation record
for_each: select id,code from archives order by code

sections.title: File manifest
sections.sql: select relative_path,sha256,bytes,missing_links from archive_files where archive_id=$1 order by relative_path
